text:
maria (support): sales asked for a temporary burst increase for Acme POC tomorrow — they want 4x QPS for 2 hours to run an inference load test. Can we do a safe temp raise?
sam (sales): @maria can you paste org id + api key + window? need to confirm contract and contact.
maria (support): org=acme-inc, api_key=sk-live-ACME1234 (they submitted form). start=2026-03-25T15:00Z, duration=2h, multiplier=4
aj (eng-platform): prefer issuing a time-limited "lease" attached to the key rather than mutating org-wide quotas. smaller blast radius and auto-expire.
ev (eng-infra): implementation idea: support creates a lease record. rate-limiter checks leases store before bucket calc. lease overrides qps for key until expires_at.
zoe (security): +1 but require manual approval for anything >2x or >1h. also denylist check: if key/org is flagged, leases must be rejected. audit trail mandatory.
maria (support): for the console UX can we have a one-click approve modal w/ comment field that writes to audit log? support needs a link from ticket to the lease.
aj (eng-platform): sounds right — console: "Temporary burst lease" modal (select org/key, multiplier, duration, comment). backend emits audit event and ticket link to telemetry.
quota-bot: NOTE: policy: temp multiplier default cap=3x, hard cap=5x, default TTL=1h unless manual override by eng-platform or security.
ev (eng-infra): metrics we need: per-key burst budget consumed, time-to-expire, and alert if >50% of burst budget used in 30m. also automatic rollback if token latency/SLO degrades >20%.
sam (sales): sales needs a short doc for SDRs — what's allowed, typical approval time, and how to request. target <=2h approvals for trials.
aj (eng-platform): rough implementation plan: small admin API (/admin/leases) + console button + background reconciler to revoke expired leases + push to edge caches. estimate ~3 sprints to MLP.
maria (support): can we special-case "verified partner" orgs for faster approvals? they'd love a one-click flow.
zoe (security): partner flow ok but must require contract id & legal signoff. everything writes to immutable audit log and include approver id. encrypt lease metadata at rest.
ev (eng-infra): operational note: edge rate-limiters cache lease state — TTL=30s to avoid drift. we also need a reconciliation job to ensure expired leases are removed from all edges.
aj (eng-platform): created INF-1298 to track work. will add schema + tests + console mocks. sample cURL:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/leases \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <eng-token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"api_key":"sk-ACME1234","qps":160,"expires_at":"2026-03-25T17:00:00Z","reason":"Acme POC load test","allowlist_ips":["22.33.44.55"]}'
```
maria (support): thanks all — I'll file the support ticket and link INF-1298. Marking blocked on eng work. :thumbsup:
sam (sales): FYI they also asked for an IP allowlist for the POC window so we should expose allowlist_ips on the lease model.
aj (eng-platform): noted, will include allowlist_ips and a denylist guard. will add a TTL and manual approval requirement surface in console.
quota-bot: REMINDER: any manual override must include approver and reason in audit and auto-expire.
